rows.proof:
Bartholomew & Company’s FY2023 trust fund summary, pages 3 and 4 of 9, printed UPSIDE DOWN in the report. 46 funds in seven groups. The statement asserts five identities per fund and all of them close: net earnings = net income + realized gain/loss; ending principal = beginning principal + transfers of principal; ending earnings = beginning earnings + net earnings + transfers of earnings; ending cash value = ending principal + ending earnings; ending market value = ending cash value + unrealized gain/loss. 230 checks. Every group subtotal foots its own funds across all fourteen columns, and the seven subtotals foot to the printed GRAND TOTALS.
TWO CELLS WERE MISREAD ON THE FIRST PASS and the identities caught both: HEALTH INSURANCE STABILIZATION beginning earnings is 3,606.88 not 3,606.49, and J & M HOWARD SDWLK/GRDS change in unrealized is (22.62) not (22.82). Both re-read at a crop and corrected before anything was written.
